title: Trade
description: Structured trade and economy data for a location.

imports.description: List of goods and resources imported by this location.

exports.description: List of goods and resources exported by this location.

resources.description: Natural resources available in or around this location.

scarcity.description: Goods or resources that are rare or in high demand.

wealth.description: General economic status (e.g., affluent, prosperous, struggling).

currency.description: Primary currency used in this location.

trade_routes.description: Major trade routes connected to this location.
